# TOMBO

> A single-file, zero-dependency CSS design system with optional JavaScript.

This is main-branch documentation and may include unreleased changes.
For an existing app, use its pinned release, not an automatic upgrade.

## Reference

- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/ai.md): Integration workflow, constraints and verification.
- [Integration recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/recipes.md): Complete settings form and scrollable table compositions.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/README.md): Vendoring, license and repository checks.
- [Foundations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/foundations.md): Colors, typography and themes.
- [Layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/layout.md): Containers, spacing and overflow.
- [Signatures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/signatures.md): Brand marks and visual intensity.
- [Forms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/forms.md): Native controls and accessible validation.
- [Topbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/topbar.md): Application header and navigation.
- [Charts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/charts.md): Figures and accessible data alternatives.
- [Behavior](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/tombo-js.md): Optional theme and copy behavior.
- [Print](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/docs/print.md): Print styles and trim marks.

## Optional

- [Full reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/llms-full.txt): Combined reference when link traversal is unavailable.
- [Component catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/examples/components.html): Live HTML examples and copyable markup.
- [CSS source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wadakatu/tombo/main/tombo.css): Authoritative tokens and selectors.
